sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:48

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:48:1
items.html:
With the Tree of Knowledge, which is the world of Assiya — for he was commanded not to eat of it, because he has no share in Assiya, only from Yetzira and above. That is, the secret of the commandment that was told to him, not to eat of the Tree of Knowledge, stems from the Sium [end] of the legs of the three worlds BYA, which was at the Chazeh [chest] of Yetzira of now. There the boundary of holiness ended, and from there downward was the dwelling of the shells. For only the discernment of the nine first ones of the eight kings that broke was sorted into holiness, which is the secret of the 288 sparks; but the discernment of their Malchuts, which fell to below the Chazeh of the general place of BYA — which are eight Malchuts, in each of which there are four phases, which in gematria is 32 — became shells that are good for nothing. And they are called the heart of stone, for they have no sorting at all until the future to come, when the Malchut of the first restriction, which was concealed in Radla [the unknown head], will be revealed; for then even SAM [Samael] will be a holy angel, for then “He will swallow up death forever” will be fulfilled, as is known.
And this is what he says, “for he was commanded not to eat of it, because he has no share in Assiya, only from Yetzira and above”: that is, in the Assiya of now, which is clothed in the dwelling of the shells and has contact with the above-mentioned heart of stone. And this is because the Assiya of that time ended entirely above the Chazeh of the general place of BYA, which is above the Chazeh of Yetzira of now. And in the secret of this Sium, the commandment prohibiting the eating of the Tree of Knowledge was told to him, that is, that he should have no connection with the shells that grip Assiya, namely in the posterior of Assiya, which remained back to back. And the eating of the Tree of Knowledge was forbidden to him, which means not to draw illumination to the posterior, for the abundance would reach the vessels that are in the above-mentioned heart of stone, and he would surely die, as in the case of the breaking of the vessels. And it will be explained below.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:48:2
items.html: Since he transgressed and ate of the Tree of Knowledge, which is Assiya, he caused a blemish in all the worlds, and all of them descended from their degree, in this manner: Yetzira clothed in Assiya. That is, the world of Assiya of that time, which stood in the first six of the world of Yetzira of now, and was therefore regarded as the world of Yetzira — for the lower one that stands in the place of the upper one becomes exactly like it (as the ARI writes below, item 60; see there) — now, after the sin of the Tree of Knowledge, fell to the discernment of the Assiya of now, which stands clothed in the dwelling of the shells. And the reason why the eating of the Tree of Knowledge caused Assiya to be clothed in the shells will be explained below, in the passage beginning “The Tree of Knowledge.”
